proof_body:
by
  intro n _ i
  refine ⟨QuaternionGroup.xa_sq i, QuaternionGroup.orderOf_xa i, QuaternionGroup.orderOf_a_one, ?_⟩
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, QuaternionGroup.card]
target_source: ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (i : ZMod (2 * n)), (QuaternionGroup.xa i : QuaternionGroup n) ^ 2 = QuaternionGroup.a (n : ZMod (2 * n)) ∧ orderOf (QuaternionGroup.xa i : QuaternionGroup n) = 4 ∧ orderOf (QuaternionGroup.a 1 : QuaternionGroup n) = 2 * n ∧ Nat.card (QuaternionGroup n) = 4 * n
